events.summary: Hi everyone, We’re back with another adventure overview. This time we are showing you one that sits at the far end of what OMEA covers: Echoes in the Abyss, a dark science fiction thriller written by E. Winters.Odin's Trial is about staying alive in the open. The Last Vigil is about a group of strangers shut in together. events.title: New Languages Are Coming to OMEA - We Need Your Ears
events.summary: Hello everyone!We are starting to give OMEA voices in languages other than English, and the first of them is ready for a listen. It is a newly trained Spanish (LatAm) voice model, and we would like your take on it before we commit to anything. Spanish is first in the queue, not the last. French and Korean are right behind it, so even if Spanish is not your thing, join the Discord and weigh in when your language comes up :)The files and the full instructions are in the #voice-and-languages channe

events.title: OMEA Demo Update - Volume Sliders and Controller Fixes
events.summary: Hello everyone! Odin's Trial, the free OMEA demo, just got another update. This one focuses on sound and controllers. Here's what changed. SoundMusic and sound effects now have their own volume sliders, and "Mute all" moved to the Audio tab to sit next to them. Sound effects also obey the effects slider now; menu clicks and pickups used to ignore it. And settings sliders no longer play at full volume while you drag them. ControllerL3 / R3 now open Info and Story Points on the dice screen too.Rum
